tool_args.rationale: The high-gradient observations establish a strong positive-to-negative reversal, and the competitive Hill-2 candidate has failed fresh confirmation. The stationary barrier-activated siphon with a square-root branch is a distinct four-parameter candidate compatible with sink-dependent reversal; fit its parameters numerically to all eight rows and test it on fresh confirmation before spending on another probe.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Eight paid rows already exceed the four-parameter model's basic identification requirement; the main unresolved question is mechanism form, so attempt the distinct archived barrier/siphon candidate before buying a larger batch.
